sentences.text: Stephen Edwin King -LRB- born September 21 , 1947 -RRB- is an American author of horror , supernatural fiction , suspense , science fiction , and fantasy .	horror	horror fiction	supernatural fiction	supernatural fiction
His books have sold more than 350 million copies , many of which have been adapted into feature films , miniseries , television shows , and comic books .
King has published 54 novels , including seven under the pen name Richard Bachman , and six non-fiction books .	Richard Bachman	Richard Bachman
He has written nearly 200 short stories , most of which have been collected in book collections .	nearly 200 short stories	Stephen King short fiction bibliography
Many of his stories are set in his home state of Maine .	Maine	Maine

His novella Rita Hayworth and Shawshank Redemption was the basis for the movie The Shawshank Redemption which is widely regarded as one of the greatest films of all time .	Rita Hayworth and Shawshank Redemption	Rita Hayworth and Shawshank Redemption	The Shawshank Redemption	The Shawshank Redemption	greatest films of all time	List of films considered the best
King has received Bram Stoker Awards , World Fantasy Awards , and British Fantasy Society Awards .	British Fantasy Society	British Fantasy Society
His novella The Way Station -LRB- 1980 -RRB- was a Nebula Award novelette nominee .	The Way Station	The Way Station	Nebula Award	Nebula Award

In 2003 , the National Book Foundation awarded him the Medal for Distinguished Contribution to American Letters .	Medal for Distinguished Contribution to American Letters	National Book Award	National Book Foundation	National Book Foundation
His short story `` The Man in the Black Suit '' -LRB- 1994 -RRB- received the O. Henry Award .	The Man in the Black Suit	The Man in the Black Suit	O. Henry Award	O. Henry Award

He has also received awards for his contribution to literature for his entire oeuvre , such as the World Fantasy Award for Life Achievement -LRB- 2004 -RRB- , the Canadian Booksellers Association Lifetime Achievement Award -LRB- 2007 -RRB- , and the Grand Master Award from the Mystery Writers of America -LRB- 2007 -RRB- .	World Fantasy Award	World Fantasy Award	World Fantasy Award for Life Achievement	World Fantasy Award for Life Achievement	Mystery Writers of America	Mystery Writers of America

In 2015 , King was awarded with a National Medal of Arts from the United States National Endowment for the Arts for his contributions to literature .	National Medal of Arts	National Medal of Arts	United States National Endowment for the Arts	National Endowment for the Arts
